app.name: M HUB Native
app.subtitle: Native companion for MCHOSE headsets
connect.title: My devices
connect.subtitle: Select a connected MCHOSE device to configure it.
connect.none: No supported device found. Connect your headset with the USB cable or the 2.4G receiver.
routine.title: Sound
routine.subtitle: Volume, microphone processing and sound effects.
routine.ai_nr.desc: Machine-learning noise reduction for the microphone.
routine.nr.desc: Removes constant background noise such as fans or hum.
routine.magic_voice.desc: Changes the microphone timbre for voice chat.
routine.mic_listen.desc: Play your own voice back through the headset.
routine.mic_listen.unsupported: Monitoring is provided by a vendor sidecar component and is not implemented natively.
routine.effects.hint: Fine-tune the headset DSP. Changes are written to the C-Media driver property store.
effects.title: Sound effects
effects.subtitle: Four DSP blocks available in the legacy C-Media audio path.
effect.brilliance.desc: Brightens high frequencies for more detail.
effect.bass.desc: Adds punch to low frequencies with an adjustable cutoff.
effect.balance.desc: Keeps loud and quiet content at a comfortable level.
effect.clarity.desc: Emphasises dialogue and voice over background noise.
eq.title: Equalizer
eq.subtitle: 10-band equalizer with the factory preset library.
eq.name: Preset name
surround.title: Virtual 7.1 surround
surround.note: The vendor implements virtual surround inside a C-Media control handler; the native backend cannot write it through the driver property store yet.
mic.title: Microphone
mic.subtitle: Microphone processing and monitoring.
mic.disabled: The microphone is disabled or unavailable. Open Windows sound settings, enable the recording device, then refresh.
firmware.title: Firmware & power
firmware.subtitle: Versions reported by the headset, plus power options.
firmware.ota_note: Firmware updates are not implemented in this native build: they require the vendor OTA SDK and per-device firmware images. Use the official MCHOSE HUB for updates.
firmware.factory.desc: Restores the headset to its factory defaults. This cannot be undone.
firmware.factory.confirm: Reset the headset to factory defaults?
firmware.not_supported: This control needs the device HID command channel, which could not be verified on this unit.
settings.title: Settings
settings.about_text: Native Rust/egui reimplementation of the MCHOSE HUB headset companion, reconstructed through reverse engineering. No WebView, no Electron.
settings.compat_text: Implemented natively: equalizer, sound effects, microphone DSP and monitoring, volumes, test sounds, driver install/repair and tray behaviour. Not implemented: firmware flashing, THX spatial audio (not needed), virtual 7.1 writes, cloud features, per-app profiles and the vendor OSD.
log.title: Log
settings.driver_hint: Install or repair the official audio driver + APO packages (requires administrator approval).
settings.close_to_tray_hint: Keep running in the notification area when the window is closed.
settings.platform_note: Vendor DSP (equalizer, effects, microphone processing) is only available on Windows. This build runs with system volume/mute on Linux and macOS; HID device support uses the same protocol.
eq.hardware_hint: Profile stored in the headset DSP; switch it over the 2.4G dongle.
eq.hardware_unavailable: Available only with the 2.4G dongle (not over Bluetooth).
